hypothesis: Contextually impossible four-digit years in Arabic extracted text can expose semantically corrupt digit order that character-density quality scores miss.

configuration.rule: flag four-digit tokens outside 1900 through document year plus five when directly preceded by explicit Arabic or French year, season, or month context
configuration.propagation: a risky page marks its document for possible query-time visual fallback
configuration.intended_use: post-retrieval risk signal for date or numeric claims, not unconditional text replacement

validation_metrics.reason: This is a development-derived risk signal and has not yet been used to access validation.

fr.reason: The failure mode and detector are Arabic-specific.

latency.note: The complete local manifest screen ran in under five seconds including artifact I/O.

conclusion: KEEP only as a query-time risk signal. It catches all four visually confirmed Arabic digit-order answer failures, but flags 45.05 percent of Arabic documents, so it does not justify unconditional OCR or VLM processing and does not itself repair evidence.
